Point Hub

Point Hub, the console of KSC Wiedikon's LedBox scoreboard, for the tablet at the scorer's table. Source: https://github.com/Lucanepa/point-hub

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://lucanepa.github.io/point-hub/fdroid/repo
